stories.title: From Campus Drone Club to Statewide AgriTech Trailblazer
stories.problemStatement: In the Cauvery delta belt, paddy blast and sheath blight disease can destroy up to 40% of seasonal yield if caught late. Traditional satellite imagery is hampered by monsoon cloud cover, while manual ground scouting is slow and labor-prohibitive across vast acreage.
stories.theBreakthrough: MAMCET student founders Karthik Rajendran and Sowmya Natarajan designed a ruggedized, lightweight carbon-fiber drone equipped with dual multispectral optics. Instead of streaming gigabytes of raw footage to remote servers, their onboard neural network parses reflectance values in real time, delivering color-coded infection heatmaps straight to the farmer's WhatsApp within 10 minutes of landing.
stories.mifJourney: Incubated in late 2025 at MASTeR Incubation Foundation, the team gained direct access to high-precision CNC routers, 3D printing, and the outdoor flight cage. MIF connected them to former ISRO scientists for aerodynamics optimization, facilitated their ₹10 Lakh TANSEED grant from StartupTN, and coordinated field trials with local farming cooperatives across Tiruchirappalli.

interview.interviewTitle: Building Autonomous Wings for Smallholder Farmers

transcript.speaker: MIF Editorial
transcript.text: Karthik, what inspired you and Sowmya to pivot from competitive racing drones to agricultural robotics?

transcript.speaker: Karthik Rajendran
transcript.text: Growing up near Siruganur, we saw farmers losing entire paddy harvests to sudden bacterial blight outbreaks. We realized that our autonomous flight controllers could detect vegetative stress days before the human eye could.

transcript.speaker: Sowmya Natarajan
transcript.text: The hardest part was running inference on-device under strict battery constraints. In the MIF IoT Lab, we spent three months quantizing our PyTorch models down to 4-bit weights so an edge board could process 30 frames per second.

transcript.speaker: Karthik Rajendran
transcript.text: Having the official MIF Startup Passport was a game changer for us. When approaching government officials and Farmer Producer Collectives, the verified QR code and institutional backing gave us instant trust.

keyTakeaways: Validate core hardware in the field directly with end users before scaling production.
On-device edge intelligence eliminates the bottleneck of rural cloud connectivity.
Institutional incubation provides structural credibility through certified Startup Passports.

stories.title: Decarbonizing Industrial Microgrids: ThermaGrid's Scale Story
stories.problemStatement: Heavy manufacturing and cold chain logistics waste millions of kilowatt-hours annually due to uncoordinated peak power spikes and unmonitored thermal inertia in industrial refrigeration systems.
stories.theBreakthrough: ThermaGrid developed predictive micro-dispatch algorithms embedded into plug-and-play DIN-rail hardware modules that autonomously predict factory cooling needs 4 hours ahead using ambient humidity and manufacturing schedules.
stories.mifJourney: Originating from MAMCET's Electrical & Electronics Engineering department, ThermaGrid was among MIF's inaugural 2024 cohort. They utilized MIF's power electronics test bench to benchmark hardware under 440V industrial grid conditions before scaling commercially.
